title: Book
description: Metadata for a single Project Gutenberg ebook.

id.description: Project Gutenberg ID number of the book.

authors.description: People credited as authors of the book.

editors.description: People credited as editors of the book.

translators.description: People credited as translators of the book.

subjects.description: Library of Congress subject headings assigned to the book.

bookshelves.description: Project Gutenberg bookshelves containing the book.

languages.description: Two-character ISO language codes of the book content.

copyright.description: Copyright status: true if copyrighted, false if public domain in the USA, null if unknown.

media_type.description: Media type of the work (for example Text, Sound, Image).

download_count.description: Number of times the book has been downloaded from Project Gutenberg.
